points.text: The tracker records that GTA6-COMPAT-LAYER now claims the stage "Exe runs".
The tracker records that MashedHugo joined the board, claiming the stage "Runnable".
The Verge reports that Take-Two shut down a GTA VI PC recompilation project.

sentences.text: The linked article reports that Take-Two filed a DMCA notice against the Leonida repository, shutting down 3,007 forks.
The linked article says that Leonida’s Discord server disappeared, with members claiming Discord banned it.
The Verge reports that Take-Two shut down the GTA VI PC recompilation project.
The linked article reports that several private PC builds can now play through Lucia's prologue and into Jason's first mission.
Yahoo Tech says GTA VI reportedly boots on PC hours after leaked Xbox build’s executable surfaces.
TechRadar describes the port as bootable but visually rough, noting rapid progress.
SSBCrack reports that a GTA 6 leaker released an Xbox build executable, raising fears of an unofficial PC port.
El-Balad says Cyberleek released the Xbox build file, linking it to Leonida GitHub.
Digg reports that Cyberleek claims to have leaked a GTA 6 development build, but the executable file was missing.

commit:f908b56.text: Five Star Recomp's commit says loader defaults to textures, disabling them with --committed-textures; released texture range stays mapped like console memory.

commit:28e5f4d.text: Xbox2Windows's commit says gpu sample slot 62 root bindings at dispatch (#2246).

commit:70f7815.text: Five Star Recomp's commit says merge lane-slots: --census-passes lists named passes, few draws, with build state; --probe-pipeline probes pixel and compute programs.

commit:e94e14f.text: Xbox2Windows's commit says shader releases mesh barriers after a wave terminates (#2241).

commit:b1e30cd.text: TuxBox's commit says xshader integrates bounded reductions with upstream EXECZ votes.
